newsitem.title: LEBANON: Libano-Francaise bank okays $100 mln EuroCds.
newsitem.headline: Libano-Francaise bank okays $100 mln EuroCds.

text.p: Shareholders in Beirut's Banque Libano-Francaise approved on Tuesday a $100 million EuroCD issue and a Bank executive said the subscription would close by Thursday.

The notes will have five-year maturities and will be priced at between 225 and 245 basis points over equivalent U.S. Treasuries, Maurice Kayrouz, Director of Merchant Banking, told Reuters after the annual shareholders meeting voted to approve the issue.
"We expect the final spread to be at the lower end," he said.
The issue is being lead managed by Indosuez, acting through Indosuez Capital Emerging Markets in London with Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) and Merrill Lynch, Kayrouz added.
"Initial indications are that the issue will be extremely oversubscribed. Closing subscription will be by Thursday the latest if not today," he added.
